semantics: Reported observations, not confirmed business truth. Financial collections include only source-bound representations selected by the existing document-validation projection. Missing, null, empty and unknown values never satisfy a predicate, including not-in. Filters are ANDed. Exact string comparison is case-sensitive. Integer-minor fields accept canonical integer strings (no separators or leading zeros) in predicates. Identifiers are mentions, never proof of ownership. No extraction or model calls occur during reads.

invoices.label: Invoices and receipts
invoices.subject: document unit, or source file when not segmented

statements.label: Bank statements
statements.subject: document unit, or source file when not segmented

transactions.label: Statement transactions
transactions.subject: transaction occurrence within one selected statement revision

line-items.label: Invoice line items
line-items.subject: line occurrence within one selected invoice revision

summary: Counts are decimal strings and count subjects in the named collection, not distinct business events. A money measure sums reported integer minor units, separately per reported currency. It is NOT an outstanding balance or reconciliation. Missing amounts and unknown currencies are counted separately, not treated as zero. checked means validation reported consistency, not human approval. review can follow completed validation that found missing values or concerns; zero checked records does NOT mean no validation was performed. Duplicate source imports are not deduplicated business events. No currency conversion. Follow row cursors to inspect exact source and representation evidence.
